review.notes: All OCR lines compared against extracted text of all 16 physical pages; physical pages 11 and 14 rendered and inspected (p.14 Table III legend and Error/Human-Intent columns at 300-400 dpi crops). Code fences are balanced; all 21 headings are printed headings. The main repair is Table III: OCR invented circled-digit footnote markers and empty circles where the PDF prints the half-filled circle used by the 'Partially Supported' legend (verified visually at 400 dpi). The legend line itself collapsed the half-filled circle to an empty one. Ref [53] prints 'genie_sim' with an underscore (verified at 300 dpi), so only the OCR backslash escape was removed. 'GenieReasoner(illustrated', 'phases:(1)', 'GenieSim[53]' and 'Appendix A1' are all printed that way in the PDF and were kept; references [1]-[69] are complete with no gaps; no spaced digits or dropped paragraphs were found.
